records.description: The selector owns activity eligibility, ranking, slots, reentry for no eligible activities and non-primary context. Method Kernel validates PM/MoC/PF/OLC method conformance after evidence exists.
records.recommendation: Do not let Method Kernel select, rank, reselection fallback or alter v1.3 selection governance.

records.description: Method Kernel declares readiness states and a readiness_decision pipeline. Runtime 40/20 already owns runtime readiness/reentry authority.
records.recommendation: Rename or map Method Kernel readiness as methodological readiness. Runtime remains final execution gate.

records.description: FND-007/FND-008 cite D4/D5 for epistemology/readiness/output sequencing. This is acceptable as boundary language but risky as runtime execution authority.
records.recommendation: Keep D4/D5 as compatibility boundary only; do not treat these rules as Runtime 40/20 gate implementations.

records.description: B0 captures semantic preload, confirmation and operational description. Method Kernel may consume evidence later, but should not replace B0 questions or adapter.
records.recommendation: Wire only downstream of B0 completion, if ever.

records.description: WorkMap Writing Assistance is documented-not-wired and not runtimeAuthority. Method Kernel should not rewrite activity/responsibility copy assistance.
records.recommendation: Keep WorkMap assistance as documentation/copy support; Method Kernel must not alter H12 coverage-only behavior.

records.description: Operational description creates evidence that Method Kernel could use, but ASRO owns literal description rules.
records.recommendation: Do not inject Method Kernel blockers into the operational description assistant.

records.description: The chip is subject to transduction QA; it does not replace transduction QA policy.
records.recommendation: Use QA policy before any runtimeAuthority registration.

records.description: Registry runtimeAuthority would be premature while D5 boundary is unresolved and package consistency mismatches persist.
The package keeps eve_pathology_hint null and diagnostic output disabled in stage 00.
records.recommendation: Preserve this boundary; do not emit pathology labels.

records.description: FND-008 names Produccion Paralela as downstream consumer boundary but does not implement it.
records.recommendation: Keep as no-execution precondition language only.
